mapper.select: select job_code, job_name, count(*) as weight_rows from job_competency_weight where job_code is not null and job_code != '' and (job_name = #{keyword} or job_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) group by job_code, job_name order by case when job_name = #{keyword} then 0 else 1 end, char_length(job_name), job_code limit #{limit}

select distinct s.skill_name from talent_job_posting p join talent_job_skill s on s.posting_id = p.id where (p.job_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.keyword = #{keyword} or p.keyword like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) and s.skill_name is not null and s.skill_name != '' limit #{limit}
